title: Impacts on Children (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to understand how their behaviour directly affects their children’s emotional safety, development, and long-term wellbeing.
learningOutcomes: Recognise how children experience harmful behaviour.
Understand the emotional and developmental impacts on children.
Identify signs of fear, withdrawal, or distress.

modules.title: Fathering and Child Impact
modules.content: Explores how children internalise their father’s behaviour.

modules.title: Emotional and Developmental Harm
modules.content: Shows how harmful behaviour affects children long-term.

modules.title: Safe Fathering Practices
modules.content: Provides tools for stability, safety, and emotional support.
